title: The regular completed coefficient reduces to the coherent tensor unit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme X with l invertible. Let S be the prescribed derived coefficient calculus [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison, def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data]. The image under S.reduction of the completed regular coefficient in degree zero [def-weil-constant-coefficient-objects] is isomorphic, in the coherent system derived category, to S.systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit. This is an isomorphism of coherent systems, not only of their separate evaluations.

proof.text: Compare the ordinary integral monoidal unit with the normalized ringed-site unit, using uniqueness of left adjoints to the same fixed internal Hom. Its unitIso and the single-complex localization comparison identify that unit with the regular completed coefficient in degree zero.

Let V be the reconstructed integral tensor unit. Its reduction is the system unit by the invertible coherent counit. Write S for the ordinary integral monoidal structure, T for the system structure, and F for reduction. Then F(1_S) is isomorphic to T(F(1_S),1_T), to T(F(1_S),F(V)), to F(S(1_S,V)), to F(V), and to 1_T. These are respectively the inverse right unitor, tensor of the counit inverse, inverse reduction tensor comparison, image of the left unitor, and counit. Compose with the image of the regular-coefficient identification.

theorem regularCoefficient_coherentReduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)] :
    Nonempty ((pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).reduction.obj
      (integralConstantCoefficientObject l E X) ≅
        (pullbackTensorCalculus l E X).systemClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit)
